query:
INSERT INTO mila_messages (id, session_id, role, content, source_chunks, created_at)
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM mila_sessions
                WHERE id = $2
                  AND user_id = $7
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                session_id,
                role,
                content,
                source_chunks as "source_chunks!: Vec<Uuid>",
                created_at
